name: How do ceramic subway tile and natural marble backsplashes compare for kitchen use?

mainEntity.name: How do ceramic subway tile and natural marble backsplashes compare for kitchen use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Subway tile and natural marble offer different balances of maintenance and style. Ceramic or porcelain subway tile is non-porous, highly resistant to cooking grease and food splatters, and easy to clean with basic household cleaners. Marble offers classic, high-end visual depth, but it is naturally porous and prone to etching from acidic foods like tomato sauce or lemon juice. If you choose marble, it requires proper sealing during installation and periodic resealing over time. As a finish contractor experienced in both standard ceramic and delicate stone, HH Remodeling helps you weigh daily maintenance against material aesthetics before purchasing your tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic subway tile resists stains and needs minimal upkeep, whereas natural marble delivers high-end character but requires routine sealing to prevent stains from cooking splatters.
